# Generated Rust bindings

Prost messages and Tonic clients and servers, emitted by the repository-owned `protoc-gen-prost` and `protoc-gen-tonic` wrappers built from a pinned Cargo lock. Every module is reachable from the single `mindclade_protocols` crate root.

## Do not edit these files

Every file in this tree is generator output. Edit the contract source under
`protocols/proto/` or `protocols/events/` and regenerate; a hand edit is reverted by the
next run and fails the drift gate in the meantime.

## Who may import this tree

The dependency direction is one way: `protocols/proto` -> `protocols/generated` ->
`sdks` -> services, workers, training, tools and internal applications. Direct
imports of this tree are limited to internal SDK implementations, generated server
transport adapters and registration, persistence protobuf mappers, and contract or
conformance tests. Every other consumer imports `sdks` instead, and an
architecture test rejects the rest.

## Regenerating and proving currency

```sh
nix develop --no-accept-flake-config --no-update-lock-file
just generate-contracts     # the sole write path for this tree
just check-contract-drift   # fails when a committed output is stale
```

Generation is one atomic transaction: the descriptor, all four transport estates, the
OpenAPI stages, the event-registry projections, SDK and gRPC coverage, and the file
manifest are staged and validated together, every projection carries the same descriptor
digest, the manifest is written last, and a failed run rolls the whole set back. The
transaction also regenerates itself a second time and requires byte-identical output, so
a generator that depended on wall-clock time or iteration order is rejected before
anything is written.

See `protocols/README.md` for the contract estate as a whole.
